blocks.x: I laughed he was good, too. Oh, he was one of the...
I think he was about the best in the punk and Susan Paul, myself.
Yeah, a lot of people say that, you know. Buck was playing piano then. I guess... Yeah. I don't remember what he sounded like on solos. Did he solo much out there?
Yeah. Was he a good chord man?

Well, I mean, uh... He was hit and missed here, but I mean, uh... He had a good ear. Uh-huh. But I mean, he didn't know all the, you know, full changes. Uh-huh. And it helped, though. I mean, he, uh... He had that, uh, you know, steady, uh, full, full beat, you know? Yeah. And it helped a lot.
Yeah, well, that's what you want. It's a good rhythm, man.
Yeah, we had good rhythm there.
